author: Jérémy Rosen
name: selection_to_pdf
description: Adds an exporter that generates a PDF contact sheet of the selected images via LaTeX.
description-extensive: This add-on turns your selected photos into a single PDF contact sheet, letting you choose how many thumbnails appear per row. It's useful for printing overviews or sharing a quick visual index of a shoot. It builds the PDF using pdflatex (a LaTeX installation) and needs a PDF viewer to open the result.
